en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abdul Kareem Bin Amro, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
One cannot copulate with the girl until there come to her nine years or ten years’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from ‘Abd al-Karim ibn ‘Amr from abu Basir who has said the following:
